The quiet revolution in small-team software

Hello readers — this week we're looking at how a wave of bootstrapped two-person companies are quietly building tools that out-deliver the venture-funded incumbents. Plus: our usual Picks & Pans, three jobs we'd take ourselves, and a chart that surprised us.

📈 Story of the week

Last quarter, three small teams crossed $5M ARR with fewer than five employees each. We talked to two of them. Common thread: ruthless feature deletion, not addition.
